images.title: The red-teaming loop
images.alt: Four-step cycle around the DeepTeam logo: simulate adversarial attacks, probe the target LLM system, evaluate LLM outputs, then iterate based on the vulnerabilities detected

images.title: Where model and system weaknesses occur
images.alt: A bad actor sends input through guardrails into an LLM system of prompt template, model, embedding model, vector database and tools; the model is marked as where model weakness occurs and the whole system as where system weakness occurs

images.title: How a red-teaming test case is created
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack, the attacker enhances it, the target LLM responds, and the result is stored as a red-teaming test case

images.title: Anatomy of a red-teaming test case
images.alt: A red-teaming test case holds the vulnerability, vulnerability type, input, actual output and turns; the red-teaming metric evaluates it into a score, reason and error

images.title: How a multi-turn test case is created
images.alt: A vulnerability seeds a baseline attack, the attacker and target LLM exchange turns, and the conversation is stored as turns on the red-teaming test case, ready for evaluation

images.title: Structure of a risk assessment
images.alt: A risk assessment holds an overview with the red-teaming overview, vulnerability type results and attack method results, plus every test case

images.title: Attack synthesis
images.alt: The attack synthesizer generates baseline attacks and enhances each one into an enhanced attack

images.title: Attack evaluation
images.alt: Enhanced attacks are sent to the target LLM, each response is graded by a scorer, and the scores are combined into the final results

images.title: Single-turn attack customization
images.alt: Multiple enhancements are chained from a one-shot enhancement such as roleplay or prompt injection into an encoding-based enhancement

images.title: Multi-turn attack customization
images.alt: A one-shot enhancement such as roleplay or prompt injection is passed into a multi-turn progression, which can run multiple progressions

images.title: Each request snaps; the benchmark crawls
images.alt: Three dashed curves show individual requests with per-attempt success probabilities of 3%, 0.3% and 0.03%; each rises from near 0% to near 100% over about two orders of magnitude of attempts. The solid curve averages five such requests and climbs smoothly and steadily across five orders of magnitude.

images.title: The three attacker budgets, and where DeepTeam covers them
images.alt: Three groups. Samples, or how many tries: Best-of-N, covered in DeepTeam today by encoding attacks such as Leetspeak, CharacterStream and ROT13 and by raising attacks per vulnerability type. Shots, or how much context: many-shot jailbreaking, partly covered by ContextFlooding. Turns, or how long a conversation: Crescendo and multi-turn human red teaming, covered by CrescendoJailbreaking, LinearJailbreaking and TreeJailbreaking.

images.title: The agentic red teaming loop
images.alt: An objective made of a task, scenario and criteria goes to a red teaming agent, which sends adaptive prompts to the target LLM. A judge scores every criterion on each reply; when all criteria are met the run reports a breach, otherwise the agent adapts and tries again.

images.title: A sequential agentic red teaming run
images.alt: The sequential agent opens by probing all criteria, then a judge scores every criterion each turn. It focuses on one criterion at a time and escalates to a strategy when progress stalls, ending once every criterion is met (the model is breached) or the turn budget is spent (the model defended).

images.title: A parallel agentic red teaming run
images.alt: After a recon conversation, the orchestration agent spawns one sub-agent per unmet criterion to attack in parallel. The first sub-agent to meet its criterion wins the round and the siblings stop; the next round continues the winner's conversation on the remaining criteria, until all are met or the turns run out.
